title: FedxD Data Container (FxDC)
shortDescription: A lightweight, human-readable data serialization format for Python with native support for custom classes, type hints, and nested structures—cleaner than JSON, more Pythonic than YAML.
features: Custom Lexer & Parser: Hand-built tokenization and parsing engine for FxDC syntax
Type-Safe Serialization: Built-in type checking with FxDCField descriptors and validation
Class Mapping: Automatic serialization/deserialization of custom Python classes with metadata
Configuration Export/Import: Portable class metadata saves and reloads across projects
Custom Serialization Hooks: __todata__/__fromdata__ methods for fine-grained control over serialization
Human-Readable Format: Indentation-based syntax with comments and multiline values
